visibleAboveHorizon.$comment: minAltitudeDegrees is the apparent altitude of the moon's center. -0.25 is about when the upper limb clears the horizon; 0 puts the center on the horizon; a positive number requires the moon to clear trees or ridges. sampleMinutes controls how often the window is checked.
